notes.title: Free Gifts - One Month Anniversary
notes.content:
Today, it's been a month since we launched Gravitational, and there's no better way to celebrate that day than to give a gift to our community!

Keep these two wonderful Wallpapers made by Felipe Bueno, artist and art director of Gravitational!


 1920 x 1080 - Lab
 1920 x 1080 - Gravitational Field
 2048 x 1080 - Lab
 2048 x 1080 - Gravitational Field
 2560 x 1440 - Lab
 2560 x 1440 - Gravitational Field

And for those who haven't bought the game yet, what are you waiting? Gravitational is now available and it supports Valve Index, HTC Vive, and Oculus Quest 2. Follow us on your favorite social media to stay tuned for news!

Thank you all!

notes.title: 1.01 Patch - Available Now
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525515/ca45eca0ac14904bd366a3af97600b2558b370ae.png

Hey guys,

We from Electric Monkeys are working to improve your game experience. We appreciate all the feedback you have sent, we hope you keep sending them. 

These are the changes of the 1.01 patch:

New features:

Option to disable the out-of-bounds warning of the physical area you can play in the settings menu.
Option to disable the tunneling effect when the character moves in the settings menu.

Adjustments:

Increase the default playable area surrounding the wheelchair (you have more space to move more freely).


[previewyoutube=opQktH_dDPM;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Gravitational - Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, my name is Hugo Campos, and I am the Technical Director at Electric Monkeys. We are proud to present Gravitational: an award-winning VR game that puts you in the epicenter of a gravitational catastrophe that threatens to destroy gravity on the planet Earth. You will take on the role of Sebastian, a brilliant scientist, development leader of gravitational control technologies at GravCorp.  Check the trailer below: 

[previewyoutube=MY-mId4R4bg;full][/previewyoutube]

Sebastian

History appears to be repeating itself for Sebastian. Years early, he was involved in a major accident, resulting in the death of his colleagues and mentor as well as suffering serious and life-changing injuries. Now, as an even bigger incident is about to happen, Sebastian is once again at its epicenter. Driven throughout the years by shame and guilt that he could not protect his friends, this time Sebastian is determined to do all he can to save the lives of millions of people. The odds may be stacked against him, but Sebastian is going to give it all he has.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525515/29db47a502029ce4316814f437a7e4084e28a360.png

Community
I would like to thank @Simplex and @Moriar for helping us improve the game. Some of you guys mentioned problems in the demo, we addressed each one of the mentioned problems. Now, you are able to play here at Steam in almost all of the VR headsets and controllers:


 Valve Index Controllers
 HTC Vive
 Oculus Rift


We are listening to you, and your feedbacks are very important to us! If you want to send a message you can do so using the Steam Community or in our Discord Channel. 

We hope you like it!
